text_blocks.snippet: Brain injury symptoms can be diverse and range from physical to cognitive and emotional changes. Common symptoms include headaches, dizziness, nausea, fatigue, and vision problems. More severe injuries can lead to prolonged loss of consciousness, seizures, and cognitive impairments like memory loss and difficulty concentrating.
